lessons.title: Have you ever…?
lessons.summary: Говори об опыте без указания точного времени.

exercises.title: Present Perfect
exercises.explanation: Используй have или has плюс третью форму глагола, когда важен опыт или результат сейчас.

exercises.example: Have you ever tried surfing abroad?

exercises.prompt: Я никогда не был в Канаде.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: I have never been to Canada.
She has already finished work.

exercises.example: I haven't decided where to go yet.

exercises.canonicalAnswer: Have you sent the email yet?
acceptedAnswers: Have you already sent the email?

exercises.canonicalAnswer: We have just arrived.

exercises.prompt: He has ___ started a new job.
Я потерял ключи, поэтому не могу войти.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: I have lost my keys, so I cannot get in.
acceptedAnswers: I've lost my keys, so I can't get in.

chapters.title: Narrating the Past
chapters.subtitle: Рассказываем о прошлом: Past Continuous против Past Simple, конструкция used to, союзы while и when

lessons.title: Past Continuous vs Past Simple
lessons.summary: Учимся описывать фон действия и внезапные события в прошлом с помощью while и when.

exercises.title: Past Continuous vs Past Simple
exercises.explanation: Past Continuous (was/were + глагол -ing) описывает длительное действие в процессе, а Past Simple — короткое действие, которое его прервало. Например: I was sleeping when the phone rang.

exercises.example: I was watching TV when you called.
We were talking when suddenly the lights went out.

exercises.prompt: I ___ a book when the doorbell rang.
exercises.explanation: Длительное действие в процессе — Past Continuous.

exercises.prompt: While she was cooking, she ___ her finger.
exercises.explanation: Короткое действие, прервавшее фон — Past Simple.

exercises.title: while и when
exercises.explanation: While обычно ставят перед длительным действием (Past Continuous), а when — перед коротким (Past Simple): While I was walking, when it started to rain.

exercises.canonicalAnswer: What were you doing last night?
acceptedAnswers: What were you doing yesterday evening?
exercises.hint: Past Continuous для вопроса о процессе

exercises.prompt: Пока я готовил ужин, зазвонил телефон.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: While I was cooking dinner, the phone rang.
acceptedAnswers: While I was making dinner, the phone rang.
exercises.hint: while + Past Continuous, then Past Simple

exercises.canonicalAnswer: I was reading a book.
What were you doing?

lessons.title: Used to and Old Habits
lessons.summary: Говорим о прошлых привычках и о том, что было раньше, с помощью used to.

exercises.title: used to
exercises.explanation: Конструкция used to + глагол описывает привычки и состояния в прошлом, которых больше нет: I used to play football. В отрицании и вопросе используем didn't use to / did you use to.

exercises.example: We used to live in a small village.

exercises.prompt: When I was a child, I ___ eat a lot of sweets.
She ___ like coffee, but now she loves it.
exercises.explanation: В отрицании после didn't — use to без -d.

exercises.example: Back then, we didn't have mobile phones.

exercises.canonicalAnswer: I used to live in Moscow.
acceptedAnswers: I used to live in Moscow
In the past I lived in Moscow.

exercises.canonicalAnswer: She didn't use to like coffee.
acceptedAnswers: She did not use to like coffee.
She never used to like coffee.

exercises.canonicalAnswer: She used to live here.

exercises.prompt: ___ you use to play any sports?
exercises.explanation: Вопрос с used to строится через Did ... use to.

exercises.example: I don't watch much TV these days.

chapters.title: Conditions and Advice
chapters.subtitle: Первый условный тип и модальные глаголы should/have to/must для совета и обязанности

lessons.title: The First Conditional
lessons.summary: Учимся говорить о реальных условиях в будущем: if + Present Simple, will + глагол.

exercises.title: First Conditional
exercises.explanation: Первый условный тип описывает реальную ситуацию в будущем. Схема: If + Present Simple, ... will + глагол. Например: If it rains, we will stay home. После if используем настоящее время, а не will.

exercises.example: If it rains, we will take an umbrella.
I will call you if I have time.

exercises.prompt: If you ___ hard, you will pass the exam.
exercises.explanation: После if в первом условном используем Present Simple, а не will.

exercises.prompt: Если завтра будет солнечно, мы пойдём на пляж.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: If it is sunny tomorrow, we will go to the beach.
acceptedAnswers: If it's sunny tomorrow, we'll go to the beach.
If it is sunny tomorrow, we'll go to the beach.

exercises.prompt: Если пойдёт дождь, мы останемся дома.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: If it rains, we will stay home.

exercises.prompt: If she comes early, we ___ dinner together.
exercises.explanation: В главной части предложения используем will + глагол.

exercises.prompt: Что ты будешь делать, если он опоздает?
exercises.canonicalAnswer: What will you do if he is late?
acceptedAnswers: What are you going to do if he is late?
What will you do if he's late?

exercises.example: If I have time, I will help you with the project.

exercises.prompt: Что ты будешь делать, если он позвонит?
exercises.canonicalAnswer: What will you do if he calls?

lessons.title: Should, Have to and Must
lessons.summary: Учимся давать советы и говорить об обязанностях с помощью should, have to и must.

exercises.title: Advice and Obligation
exercises.explanation: Should — это совет («тебе следует»). Have to и must — обязанность («должен», «нужно»). Must not означает строгий запрет («нельзя»). После всех этих глаголов идёт инфинитив без to (кроме have to).

exercises.example: You look tired. You should rest for a while.

exercises.prompt: You look sick. You ___ see a doctor.
exercises.explanation: После should глагол идёт без частицы to.

exercises.canonicalAnswer: You should rest more.
You should see a doctor.

exercises.prompt: I ___ get up early tomorrow because I have a meeting.
exercises.explanation: Have to выражает обязанность или необходимость.

exercises.canonicalAnswer: I have to get up early tomorrow.
acceptedAnswers: I must get up early tomorrow.
I need to get up early tomorrow.

exercises.example: This is a hospital. You must not smoke here.

exercises.canonicalAnswer: You must not smoke here.

exercises.prompt: Students ___ wear a uniform at this school. It is a rule.
